schema: Observation-based detail planning map v1; not a spatial treatment selector
coordinate_system: Native capture XY metres: X east, Y south; north is up on the map. These are observation positions, not surface footprints.
limits: 185 disconnected construction windows,669 paired stations; schematic traces connect samples only within each window. Neither continuous route nor full-area surface coverage is established.
coverage: Six location proposals; all remaining survey observations unassigned. No confirmed D or approved simplification.

places.title: Roadside wall: readable planes and contact

regions.name: Near wall
regions.required_detail: Local planes, corners, shelves and convincing rock-ground contact; preserve broad shape and material scale.
regions.candidate_omissions: Pores and tiny cracks may use material detail where they do not change the visible shape. No blanket wall simplification.

places.context_near_contact_note: Separate nearby bank/wall requires A attention; not the same physical surface.
places.title: Dominant massif above a separate close bank

regions.name: Upper-left massif
regions.required_detail: Characteristic outline, broad planes, shelves and large divisions; retain the shape that produces major shading.
regions.candidate_omissions: Uniform pores and small geometric chips are unsupported in this view. The summit is clipped by the frame; its unseen continuation remains unresolved.

places.title: Close rock and broad slope need different scales

regions.name: Near right bank
regions.required_detail: Readable corners, plane changes, bank top/base transitions and coherent rock material scale.
regions.candidate_omissions: Use materials for grain and microcracks; retain the visible bank shape.

regions.name: Broad upper slope
regions.required_detail: Broad landform, outcrop bands, ledges and spatial material variation. Review the additional road approaches before any downgrade.
regions.candidate_omissions: Do not spread near-bank microrelief uniformly across the slope; diagnostic colours do not identify rock, soil or vegetation.

places.context_near_contact_note: Separate nearby bank/wall requires A attention; not the same physical surface.
places.title: Dominant peak: protect faces as well as skyline

regions.name: Central peak
regions.required_detail: Skyline, characteristic large cuts, broad faces and ledges; preserve forms responsible for major shading.
regions.candidate_omissions: Uniform fine cracks and pores are unsupported. Skyline-only treatment would omit readable faces; closer views remain unresolved.

places.title: Near bank and distant slope: preserve transitions

regions.name: Near right bank
regions.required_detail: Larger planes, convex changes, road-side contact and the transition into upper ground. Keep grain at a believable material scale.
regions.candidate_omissions: Do not model repeated tiny chips unless they change readable shape. The coloured central strip does not establish a stream or material class.

places.context_near_contact_note: Separate nearby bank/wall requires A attention; not the same physical surface.
places.title: Sea-facing ridge and foreground banks are separate

regions.name: Distant sea-facing ridge
regions.required_detail: Skyline, large divisions, broad colour structure and coherent apparent texture scale.
regions.candidate_omissions: Fine interior geometry is unsupported in this view. BACKGROUND_LOW_PRIORITY is withheld until closer appearances and indirect contributions are reviewed.
